hero.subtitle: Less admin, more beauty. Your team calendar, clients, reminders and AI setup — in one calm workspace for your salon.
hero.note: 14-day free trial · made for beauty businesses in Vietnam

dive.title: Step inside.
dive.sub: Stylists at work. Clients in the chair. The phone never stops.

pain1.title:
23 new messages.
Before the first coffee.
pain1.sub: Answering Zalo and copying bookings into a notebook eats hours every week — e.g. 2–3 hours.
pain1.chat1: Hi, can I come at 3pm tomorrow?
pain1.chat5: How much is gel + nail art?

pain2.title:
Two clients. One slot.
One forgotten reminder.
pain2.sub: Double bookings, no-shows and stress at reception — lost clients, lost revenue.

calendar.title:
One calendar.
The whole team.
calendar.sub: Every stylist, every break, every booking. No more double bookings.

reminders.title: Reminders send themselves.
reminders.sub: Confirmations and reminders go out by Zalo or email. Fewer empty chairs.
reminders.msg: Hi Thu Trang! See you tomorrow at 15:00 for gel nails with Mai. Reply to change your time.

assistant.title:
Too busy to check?
Just ask.
assistant.sub: Answers come from your salon's own calendar, with a ready-made Zalo reply.
assistant.q: Any free slot for gel nails tomorrow afternoon with Mai?
assistant.a: Mai is free tomorrow at 14:00 and 16:30 (gel nails, 60 min). Draft a reply?
assistant.privacy: Uses your salon's own data. No customer personal data goes to the AI model.

finale.title:
From Zalo to booked.
In seconds.
finale.sub: Check real availability, send free slots, book it. The client gets a confirmation automatically.
finale.ask: Hi! Can I book gel nails tomorrow afternoon?
finale.offer: Tomorrow we have 14:00 or 16:30 with Mai (gel nails, 60 min). Which suits you?
finale.confirm: Booked: gel nails with Mai, tomorrow 16:30. We'll remind you the day before.

calm.title:
Calmer reception.
Time back.
calm.sub: Your whole day at a glance: bookings, clients and numbers in one place.

switch.title: Switch in minutes.
switch.sub: Already using another app or a notebook? Upload a photo of your price list — AI sets up your services. Every plan.
